contentHtml:
Have you ever wondered what MOHRE stands for? The UAE Ministry of Human Resource and Emiratisation is responsible for managing the labor force and the employment process in the UAE’s public and private industries. Over the last several years, it has launched multiple efforts to boost the country’s labor market and give chances for local talent. Find out what services, projects, and procedures fall within the authority of MOHRE.

MOHRE Responsibilities and Role

The Ministry of Human Resource UAE is responsible for establishing and enforcing labor laws, rules, and policies to guarantee that workers and employers are treated fairly. It also manages employment contracts, work permits, and work cards for UAE locals and expats. 

MOHRE assists job seekers in locating relevant employment prospects via internet platforms and job search services. This implies that they offer career counseling, skill development programs, and career path recommendations.

They also promote Emirati citizens’ engagement in the commercial workforce and motivate businesses to recruit Emiratis and utilize domestic talent. Employers can contact MOHRE for help with employee-related concerns such as recruiting, workers’ rights, and adherence to regulations.

Implementation of Emiratisation  for Employment

The development of Emiratisation , which aims to increase Emirati contribution to employment opportunities, is critical to the goals of the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation  (MOHRE). In pursuit of this purpose, the MOHRE develops thorough Emiratisation policies, actively oversees their implementation, and performs extensive employment market research. 

The Ministry offers career advice and counseling to Emirati candidates and promotes small businesses and the national workforce through self-employment initiatives.

MOHRE Services for Emiratisation  in the UAE

MOHRE adopts specific rules and policies to offer services to the growing Emirati workforce and the Ministry of Human Resource Development in the UAE. Here is a list of some of the services MOHRE provides to employers and employees.

MOHRE Emiratisation Services for Companies

MOHRE offers valuable services for companies and organizations. They have a smooth procedure and clear requirements for workforce management. These effective services include:

Work Visas and Permits for Employees

The MOHRE offers employment authorization to employees operating in the UAE. The company can apply for a work visa or permit by sending current employee images, copies of the individual’s valid passport, a letter of permission from the competent government, and educational records approved by the authorities in the employee’s home country.

Employer Illegal Absence or Escape

If an employee leaves without the employer’s permission, MOHRE gives the company the authority to report the issue. For this, the employer must present documentation such as a copy of the employee’s passport, residency permission, work visa information, and the employer’s legitimate ID card.

Fines and Penalties Payments

Employers are permitted to pay the penalties accrued by their domestic workers through MOHRE. To pay a fine, employers must provide copies of the employer’s passport, the employer’s original valid ID card, and an actual valid ID card for the worker.

MOHRE Emiratisation Services for Workers

MOHRE not only meets the demands of businesses but also those of employees in the UAE.

Abshir Card for Emirati

The Abshir Card is an offer card available to UAE residents working in the commercial sector. To obtain an Abshir card, you must be an Emirati and hold a registered labor card. You must have at least a month of work experience in a single company, be approved for pensions, safety net benefits, and retirement plans, and have a minimum of three months of income transfers through the Wages Protection System.
After you apply, MOHRE will provide the card within seven working days. When the card expires, MOHRE automatically renews it in the system without further action.

Workers Salary Problems and Settlement

To submit a complaint about pay concerns, MOHRE requests that applications be sent through the service’s delivery channels. No documentation is required. The employee must also be registered in the firm’s databases. MOHRE generally handles wage concerns for private-sector workers.

Financial Guarantee and Liquidation

The service enables workers to receive remuneration on behalf of the recipient. To get this benefit, employees must have a court decision of liquidation and employer permission.
Before starting the service, you must provide the court letter to the Labour Relations Section, which includes the bank guarantee in favor of the workers. In the lack of a court judgment, the bank guarantee will be triggered based on the employer’s choice, with the conclusion reported within three working days.

Coverage for Injuries and Accidents

MOHRE also guarantees that employees receive coverage from their individual employers in the event of any occupational dangers. To use this facility, employees must have a job contract and a medical report from the health authority that establishes the disability percentage. Such petitions are typically responded to within five business days.
Additionally, MOHRE inspects the workplace, responds to queries, and investigates complaints. Both employers and employees have the right to file MOHRE labor complaints. When all other avenues have been explored, the final step is to file a case before Dubai’s courts. You can safeguard your rights by filing a civil lawsuit in the UAE.

MOHRE Online Services

MOHRE has created a digital platform for employees and employers. Their e-enquiry site allows you to verify the status of your wage certificate, work permit, labor ID card, and other documents online. To use these services, you must first register with the MOHRE.

MOHRE Android App

MOHRE additionally introduced an app that allows you to apply immediately for all the jobs and work-related services you require. The MOHRE UAE app serves employees, workers, domestic workers, and sponsors. It is the most crucial government application in the UAE.

Conclusion

In the UAE’s employment environment, the Ministry of Human Resource and Emiratisation stands out as an efficient protector, assuring peace, civility, and protection for all. Whether you’re an employer looking for a reliable job or an employee navigating workplace difficulties, MOHRE’s extensive site and services provide advice at every stage. The UAE government’s MOHRE initiative pledges to establish an ecosystem where rights and development are safeguarded, nourished, and celebrated.
